questions.q: A matrix has shape $5 \times 4$ (like the page's students × subjects grades table). What does that mean?
questions.explain: In $m \times n$ notation the first number is always the rows, the second the columns: 5 students (rows) × 4 subjects (columns).

questions.q: In the inventory matrix (rows Store A, B, C; columns Red, Blue, Green) $\begin{bmatrix} 3 & 7 & 2 \\ 5 & 1 & 8 \\ 4 & 6 & 9 \end{bmatrix}$, what is $A[2, 3]$?
questions.explain: $A[i, j]$ = row $i$, column $j$: row 2 (Store B), column 3 (Green) is 8. Reading column 2, row 3 instead gives 6.

questions.q: How many numbers are in a single **colour** (RGB) Full-HD image of 1920×1080 pixels?
questions.explain: Each colour channel is a 1920×1080 matrix of 2,073,600 numbers, and there are 3 channels: $3 \times 2{,}073{,}600 = 6{,}220{,}800$.

questions.q: What is the shape of a **row vector** with 4 entries?
questions.explain: A row vector has one row: $1 \times n$. A $4 \times 1$ shape is a column vector.
